title: Big-window cars
question: From PR #35 (questions 6 and 17): is being spotted through windows and open doors fair, and can you tell from outside which wall cells are windows? Should every car have big windows, or keep a mix?
conclusion:
Being spotted through the windows makes being on the outside of the train interesting. It makes me also wonder if we should have our own view cone inside the windows or inside of the car when we are at the end of it though..

I think a mix is best, big windows definitely make it tougher to use the outside of the train, but they do encourage using the roof of the train so that's good.
